questions.question: Peter said the man chosen to replace Judas must have been with the apostles the whole time. From when until when?

answers.text: From John the Baptist's baptism until Jesus was taken up
From the wedding at Cana until the cross
From the Sermon on the Mount until the tomb

questions.question: Peter said the man chosen to replace Judas must become a witness with the apostles of Jesus' resurrection. True or false?
Joseph and Matthias were proposed to replace Judas as an apostle. What did the believers do before anything was decided?

answers.text: They let the two men speak
